create_make_dataset: create a dataset generator from a file of action trajectories for supervised learning
build_net_fn: build a Haiku neural network with configurable hidden layers for Hearts policy prediction
test_accuracy: test the classification accuracy of the trained policy network on a batch of examples
run_main: run the supervised learning training loop with configurable iterations, batch size, and checkpointing
summarize_batch: summarize how to batch a one-at-a-time dataset generator into fixed-size observation-label batches
